correctness.rationale: PASS. From Ardila Proposition 2.8 every bisubset has origin slack sigma=n^2-(u-v)^2 and squared intrinsic normal [u(n-u)+v(n-v)]/n. Hence D^2=n sigma^2/[u(n-u)+v(n-v)]. For |u-v|<=n-2 the denominator bound places D strictly beyond n(2n-1)^2/(n-1); the remaining (n-1,0) and (0,n-1) give the optimum, 2n facets. Averaging under the full symmetry makes the origin optimal; inequalities of these tangent facets force x_j,y_j>=0 and sum zero, yielding unique center. n=2 six facets give the exceptional incenter interval. Independent enumeration all 3^n-3 valid bisubsets for n=2..7 gave radii squared 16,75/2,196/3,405/4,726/5,1183/6 and counts 2,6,8,10,12,14. Finite checks corroborate the full algebraic argument.
